decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Specific structural defect report ref. 2009 dated 29th January 2025 prepared by SWM Structures Ltd.; Location plan; Construction Management Plan pro-forma version 3 dated 01/01/2025; Heritage Appraisal dated April 2025 prepared by The Heritage Practice; Drawing no. 1A, 2A, 3A, 4A, 5B, 6B, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 17C, 18C, 19B, 20, 23, 24A, 25, 26, 27; Design and Access Statement dated 15 December 2025 prepared by Hamways.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and policies DH1 and DH2 of the Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2025-2040.
description: External alterations and refurbishment including changes to the rear at first floor upper level, painting of the front facade and replacement windows.
